item.title: Show Ownership in Interviews 🚀 • Use: “I led a team to reduce costs by 20% in six months.” • Share a time you proactively solved a problem. 🔍 • Describe how you improved a process or project. • Highlight your role in a successful team project. • Quantify results to demonstrate impact. What specific examples of ownership can you share in your next interview? #interview #career #ScalePilot #SocialPilot #AIAutomations
